Although the usage I showed above should be ok, [doc://glob] has a few caveats one should be aware of: It does not list filenames beginning with a dot by default, and it splits its argument on whitespace, which may be important in case you are interpolating variables into the pattern - you can use File::Glob ':bsd_glob'; to alleviate the latter caveat. Make sure to read all of [doc://glob] and [doc://File::Glob].
